directoryStems.mcq-754300e4e14e133ec8506c3d: בת 84, מגיעה להערכה גריאטרית כוללנית ומבקשת הפניה לבדיקת ממוגרפיה. היא מאוד כועסת שהבדיקה אינה בסל הבריאות עבורה. מה אפשר להסביר לה על התועלת בביצוע ממוגרפיה שגרתית בנשים מעל גיל 75?
directoryStems.mcq-d5b75af017acdfc07fa6a4a2: An 81-year-old man has a 2 cm breast mass. Biopsy shows invasive ductal carcinoma that is estrogen-receptor positive, progesterone-receptor positive, and HER2 negative. He has mild cognitive impairment (MMSE 24/30), lives independently with home-aide support, and has well-controlled diabetes and hypertension. Geriatric assessment shows mild functional limitations and good social support. Which drug does Hazzard prefer for adjuvant endocrine therapy in men?
directoryStems.mcq-212b643daa9c591d6cffc1f9: A 71-year-old woman with localized hormone receptor-positive breast cancer has recurrent falls and mild cognitive decline. Before selecting treatment, her clinicians want to estimate life expectancy and treatment tolerability. Which assessment is designed to uncover functional, medical, and social deficits that may be missed by a routine history and physical examination?
directoryStems.mcq-a3c9935c6e8734bbc5ea347d: A 76-year-old Hispanic woman with limited English presents with her son for a breast lump first noticed four months ago. Imaging and biopsy show a 3.5 cm invasive ductal carcinoma with axillary lymph node involvement. She has Medicare with limited supplemental coverage, lives in a rural area 90 miles from the cancer center, and lacks reliable transportation. Her son works two jobs and has limited availability. Which referral directly follows Hazzard's recommendation for patients at risk of problems with system navigation and social issues?
directoryStems.mcq-52bf851ce3b7623b16e2cae1: A 77-year-old woman has undergone breast-conserving surgery for a small, hormone receptor-positive, node-negative tumor. She plans endocrine therapy and is considering omission of radiation. What oncologic trade-off does Hazzard describe for appropriately selected patients?
directoryStems.mcq-62582f4cfcbb70a0a0c01001: An older woman newly diagnosed with metastatic breast cancer has symptoms and is continuing oncologic assessment and treatment. When does Hazzard recommend considering palliative care?
directoryStems.mcq-4984f7f1c3a21e7dcc93c8e2: An older woman has had lumpectomy for a small, hormone receptor-positive, node-negative breast cancer. She plans to take endocrine therapy and is discussing omission of breast irradiation. In the selected population described by Hazzard, what difference is expected compared with adding irradiation?
directoryStems.mcq-128dd7b51db5c96a286ad396: What does comprehensive geriatric assessment add to treatment planning for an older woman with breast cancer?
directoryStems.mcq-c9be0054fbc68b730b224631: A woman with breast cancer and bone metastases asks why denosumab or a bisphosphonate has been proposed. What role does Hazzard describe for this treatment?
directoryStems.mcq-4adf25ce6341971ebdd52dc8: An 81-year-old woman treated for ER-positive/PR-positive breast cancer 5 years ago has new back pain and weight loss. MRI shows multiple vertebral metastases, and biopsy confirms recurrent breast cancer. She has mild cognitive impairment, lives in assisted living, and has a creatinine clearance of 42 mL/min. She declines further chemotherapy but is willing to discuss endocrine treatment. Her metastases are not rapidly progressive or life-threatening. Which approach accords with Hazzard?
directoryStems.mcq-e761fdbaf9a3e692c91a5d37: איזה מהבאים מהווה גורם סיכון לסרטן שד בנשים?
directoryStems.mcq-6b33c388396f05e09b68141c: בת 77, לוקה בסרטן שד גרורתי ומקבלת מספר תרופות. באיזה מהבאים מתואר נכונה טיפול עם תופעת הלוואי הצפויה בעקבותיו?
directoryStems.mcq-550fdfd2885a7718c788d9b9:
בת 82 אובחנה עם ממאירות שד ומתחילה טיפול אונקולוגי.
איזו מבין תופעות הלוואי מתאימה לטיפול התרופתי שעשויה לקבל?
